title: What about what? What else were they invented for?
html_source: Stephen’s response, while mechanical and arrogant (and totally piggish), indicates that he has thought of arousal during this time.

anchor.text: What about what? What else were they invented for?
anchor.prefix: Sell your soul for that, do, dyed rags pinned round a squaw. More tell me, more still!! On the top of the Howth tram alone crying to the rain: naked women! What about that, eh?
